Bash(gh pr create --title "Add kit/bundle pricing for vendor part bundles" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Add project kits feature for tracking vendor bundle pricing \(e.g., tube laser bundles\)
- Per-project item source tracking: parts can be "Make In-House" or "Part of Kit"
- Kit vs in-house cost comparison with labor + material breakdown
- Kit management slideout UI on project dashboard
- Part sourcing toggle on routing page \(uses selected project filter as context\)

## Features
- **Project Kits**: Create kits with number, name, vendor, price, and use_kit toggle
- **Item Sources**: Assign items to kits per-project \(same part can be kit on one project, make on another\)
- **Cost Comparison**: Shows kit price vs calculated in-house cost \(labor + materials × quantities\)
- **Savings Display**: Green for savings, red for extra cost vs in-house manufacturing

## Database Changes
- `project_kits` table: kit definitions per project
- `project_item_source` table: item-to-kit assignments with source_type

## Files Changed
- `backend/app/routes/kits.py` - Full CRUD API for kits and item sources
- `backend/migrations/2026-07-09_project_kits.sql` - Database schema
- `backend/app/services/cost_estimate.py` - Kit cost integration
- `frontend/src/components/KitManagementSlideout.vue` - Kit management UI
- `frontend/src/views/MrpRoutingView.vue` - Part sourcing UI on routing page
- `frontend/src/views/MrpDashboardView.vue` - Manage Kits button and kit cost display

## Test plan
- [ ] Create a kit on project dashboard via "Manage Kits" button
- [ ] Assign parts to kit on routing page using "Part Source" toggle
- [ ] Verify in-house cost calculation includes labor + materials × quantities
- [ ] Verify cost estimate shows kit_cost and excludes kit items from individual costing
- [ ] Toggle use_kit off and verify parts fall back to in-house costing

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
